categories.label: Bank Interest
categories.description: Interest credited by any bank on any cash or investment account

categories.label: Pension Payments
categories.description: Regular and lump-sum pension drawdowns paid to members

categories.label: Member Contributions
categories.description: Contributions and re-contributions into the fund by members of any kind

categories.label: ATO Tax Payment
categories.description: Tax instalments, PAYG, or tax balances paid to the ATO

categories.label: ATO Tax Refund
categories.description: Tax refunds received from the ATO

categories.label: Investment Income
categories.description: Dividends, trust distributions, and managed fund income received
examples: Direct Credit 531532 NAB INTERIM DIV DV251/01064980

categories.label: Broker Settlements
categories.description: Buy or sell trade settlements for shares, ETFs, or other securities

categories.label: Regulatory Fees
categories.description: ASIC levies, ASX fees, and other government or regulatory charges

categories.label: Administration Fees
categories.description: Accounting, audit, fund management, and administration fees

categories.label: Insurance Premiums
categories.description: Life insurance, TPD, and income protection premium payments

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Transactions that genuinely do not fit any of the above categories — use as a last resort only
